# dreamrouter_wan (Resource)

The settings of an existing internet connection (Settings → Internet), e.g. "Internet 1" or "Internet 2": PPPoE login, VLAN, DHCP or static, DNS, and optionally the port it uses. Changing a working connection makes it reconnect; the provider then watches it for up to two minutes and puts the previous settings (or ports) back if it doesn't come back. Review plans for the primary connection carefully: it carries your internet. Connections can't be deleted, so destroying this resource leaves the connection as it is.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "eir_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

# A second line as failover: eir's PPPoE login on VLAN 10, on Port 3.
resource "dreamrouter_wan" "failover" {
  name     = "Internet 2"
  type     = "pppoe"
  username = "eir@eir.ie"
  password = var.eir_password
  vlan     = 10
  port     = "Port 3"
  # primary = true   # switch traffic to this line
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the connection, e.g. "Internet 2" (case-insensitive). Changing it manages another connection.
- `type` (String) "pppoe", "dhcp" or "static".

### Optional

- `dns_servers` (List of String) DNS servers the router itself uses, up to two IPv4 addresses. Left out: the provider's.
- `force_port` (Boolean) Move to port even if LAN devices are connected to it (they lose their connection).
- `gateway` (String) Static gateway; required for static.
- `ip` (String) Static address with prefix, e.g. "203.0.113.10/24"; required for static.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) PPPoE password; required for pppoe. Changed in the web UI, it is set back.
- `port` (String) The port the connection uses: its name ("Port 3", "SFP+ 1"), number ("3") or interface ("eth2"). The port it leaves becomes a LAN port. Left out: not managed.
- `primary` (Boolean) true makes this the primary connection: new traffic goes out through it and the previous primary becomes its failover. The provider checks that traffic really moves and switches back if not. Set it on one connection only; false only checks (switch by setting true on the other connection). Left out: not managed.
- `username` (String) PPPoE username; required for pppoe.
- `vlan` (Number) VLAN ID the provider uses, 1 to 4094 (e.g. 10 on Irish fibre lines). Left out: no VLAN.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The connection's ID on the router.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an internet connection by its name:
terraform import dreamrouter_wan.failover "Internet 2"
```
